$:set -euo pipefail
p=user/codespaces/shiny-robot-v64x5jj4v4q2x96
state(){ gh api "$p" --jq .state; }
s=$(state); echo "INITIAL=$s"
case "$s" in Shutdown) ;; *) gh api --method POST "$p/stop" --jq .state; for i in $(seq 1 30); do s=$(state); echo "STOP=$s"; [ "$s" = Shutdown ] && break; sleep 3; done; [ "$s" = Shutdown ];; esac
gh api --method POST "$p/start" --jq .state
for i in $(seq 1 35); do s=$(state); printf 'START=%s\n' "$s"; [ "$s" = Available ] && exit 0; sleep 4; done
exit 1
